items.q: And then I sang, and Lil Hardin was on piano.

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Vocallion with King Oliver and Lil Armstrong. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that right.

ctx.x: I was just going to say, and Lil Armstrong, she wore some clothes. Lil paid I think more money for her clothes than we did. Yeah, she wore -- she was clothes conscious. She spent a lot of money. In fact, Lil didn't have to bother about money, because her mother was crazy about her, you know, and she took more or less care of her. So Lil's mother -- and Lil's mother thought she was too good for Louis, you know. She didn't want Lil to marry Louis.
